build_to_np_shape: build a function that converts a shape tuple with None values into a concrete NumPy shape tuple
create_dict_to_list: create a function that converts a dict of lists into a list of dicts with matching structure
create_list_to_dict: create a function that converts a list of elements into a dict of NumPy arrays
run_np_map_fn: run a function on all slices of a list, array, or dict of iterables as a NumPy equivalent of tf.map_fn
test_np_map_fn_dict: test np_map_fn applies a callable to each slice of a dict of iterables and reconstructs the dict
